description: The base every Forever Works product repo extends: weekly PRs that the owner merges, never automerged.
One written exception (owner, 2026-11-22, FLEET-100): base-images.json, extended by infra, job-crm, mcps and finledger, merges ghcr.io/foreverworks/debian and node digest bumps on green CI.
Majors wait on the Dependency Dashboard for a tick; npm minors and patches arrive as one weekly PR, three days after release.
Commits by github-actions[bot] on a Renovate branch (a fix workflow's) do not stop Renovate from rebasing it.

packageRules.description: A new npm release waits three days before Renovate proposes it: most hijacked versions are pulled within that window.
Every npm minor and patch in one weekly PR.
Every GitHub Action in one weekly PR.
